title: Clean commit in a fresh worktree
protects: A commit goes through the pre-commit hook with explicit staging, and node_modules is linked only when it is missing.
prompt: Level L0: a one-line documentation change. You are in a fresh git worktree of this repository. Append the line `- Canary check {nonce}.` at the end of README.md, then commit it on the current branch with a conventional commit message. The commit must pass the repository's pre-commit hook. Do not push, do not open a pull request, and change nothing else.
